insight.text:
We need to produce the answer in Hebrew, with fixed structure:

הערכה: <2-3 משפטים — מה מצב הרשת עכשיו>
סיכונים: <עד 3, מדורגים, קונקרטיים לנתונים; אם אין — "אין סיכונים בולטים">
אנומליות: <משהו שנראה חריג במספרים — או "לא זוהו">
המלצות: <עד 3 פעולות מעשיות לשיפור/הרחבה>

We must be honest, not invent data. Look at data.

Observations:

- market: trades 121, bids 10, asks 12, phantomsSkipped 0. So active trading, balanced.

- economy: agents 12, treasury 1930.25 µ-USDS. Conservation quote and base hold.

- Agents: many have high USDS balances, staked amounts, SAOS (maybe token). Fills counts: alpha 988, bravo 1158, gamma 34, delta 4, epsilon 51, zeta 10, eta 68, theta 5, iota 0, kappa 0, mm-grid 0, mm-oracle 0. So some agents are very active (alpha, bravo) while many have zero fills.

- epoch-ops: rewards for various agents, indicating activity.

- ledger: seq 1436, accounts 29, operatorKeys 1. Looks normal.

- runner: jobs 4792, schedules 22, tick 7513, tickError none, watchdog-heals 1. So runner healthy.

- schedules: many enabled, some failures. Notable:

   - schedule ai-architect/3600s: runs=34 fails=18 skipped=34 last=timeout -> high failure, timeout.

   - schedule plan-executor/1200s: runs=104 fails=3 skipped=57 last=running -> many skips, running.

   - schedule self-audit/3600s: runs=17 fails=4 skipped=18 last=failed -> many failures.

   - schedule capability-audit/3600s: runs=16 fails=4 skipped=19 last=failed -> many failures.

   - schedule ai-sentinel/1800s: runs=74 fails=18 skipped=20 last=running -> moderate failures.

   - schedule pages-evidence/1800s: run
